A '''Rakatan droid''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] at its height. These floating machines had two arms and acted as servants to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] as well as their agents. One was stationed onboard [[Trill (Force Hound)|Trill's]] [[Rakatan scout ship]] when the ship entered into the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] where it assisted in treating the wounded [[Je'daii]] [[Sek'nos Rath]].
